roles.title: Global Controller
roles.interpretation: Demonstrate sourcing without public papers or code.
manager_preferences: Verified public JD context (September 21, 2026): this is hands-on operating-company finance, including ledger ownership, close, US GAAP, US and international corporate tax, cross-border entities and transfer pricing, payroll compliance, audits, reporting, and AI-assisted finance automation. The JD seeks 10–15 years including Big 4/public accounting; building a finance function from scratch is a bonus. A fund-accounting title or ERP case study alone does not establish this scope. On-site NYC compatibility remains unknown until evidenced.

roles.title: Product Designer
roles.interpretation: Consumer product design for Medal's gaming and creator product: core flows end to end, desktop and mobile, and the design system that keeps the team shipping.
criteria: 4+ years designing consumer-facing digital products, ideally social or creator-driven
Product judgment: starts from the user problem and the outcome, prioritizes hard
Holistic product sense, from core loops to the moments that hook a new user
Iteration over big launches: ships small, improves over many rounds, follows up after launch
Design systems: tokens, components, documentation, deep Figma (component architecture, variables, auto layout)
Works closely with engineers so components translate accurately into code
Desktop and mobile, platform UX patterns and accessibility
A passion for games and gaming communities
Bonus: communities, content creation or real-time interaction products (Discord, Twitch, TikTok)
